hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Review combined reward balances and portability options in plain English to advance the Family Holiday Fund.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer is evaluating reward balances distributed across three partner programmes with a goal to fund a family holiday.
hypotheses.storyTension: Complexity of transferring points between partner programmes without incurring confusion or technical jargon.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Clear, jargon-free presentation of combined balances and transfer options directly supporting the Family Holiday Fund milestone.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Gain a clear, unified view of portability and goal progress across reward programmes.
prohibitedDetours: Introducing technical jargon or complex terms
Employing gamification elements like streaks or leaderboards

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Understand transfer mechanics clearly to optimize multi-partner reward usage.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer wants to consolidate or move earned rewards between connected partner programmes.
hypotheses.storyTension: Unclear transfer rules or overly technical explanations creating friction.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Transparent, simple explanations of transfer mechanics and long-term value.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Gain confidence in cross-programme portability choices.
prohibitedDetours: Using manipulative urgency or artificial scarcity
